name_zh: 农业/巴拉圭/大豆/出口/土地/格罗/卡特/阿亚拉/转基因
description_zh: 巴拉圭农业主要以大豆出口为核心，大豆种植面积快速扩大，从20世纪90年代的200万公顷增加到2015年的800万公顷，成为世界第三大大豆出口国。埃拉斯莫·格罗（Eralmo Duarte Gro）因大豆出口政策贡献极大，被誉为"大豆之父"。乔治·卡特（George W. Carter）领导美国国际开发署，协助巴拉圭农业现代化，奥斯瓦尔多·阿亚拉（Osvaldo Ayala）教授在转基因大豆育种方面取得突破，被誉为"巴拉圭农学之父"。
description_en: Paraguay's agriculture is centered on soybean exports, with soybean planting area rapidly expanding from 2 million hectares in 1990s to 8 million hectares in 2015, making it the world's third largest soybean exporter. Eralmo Duarte Gro is known as "Soybean Father" for his contributions to soybean export policies. George W. Carter led the US Agency for International Development to assist Paraguay's agricultural modernization. Osvaldo Ayala is a professor who achieved breakthroughs in genetically modified soybean breeding, known as "Father of Paraguayan Agriculture".
reason_zh: PY-AGR-001 代表了巴拉圭如何通过大豆出口转型，实现农业现代化，以及通过国际合作和技术创新推动国家发展，体现了拉美农业经济的典型特征。
reason_en: PY-AGR-001 represents how Paraguay transforms through soybean exports, achieves agricultural modernization, and promotes national development through international cooperation and technological innovation, embodies typical characteristics of Latin American agricultural economy.
